# Wellward — Implementation Notes

## Source
- ColorLib "Covid" template: https://colorlib.com/wp/template/covid/
- Preview: https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/covid/
- Replicated as: Wellward (apps/wellward)

## Section order (top to bottom)
1. Navbar — sticky, logo with purple dot, nav links with Prevention dropdown
2. Hero — split layout, left text + right illustration, CTA button
3. Statistics — 3 stat cards with virus icons, numbers, labels
4. About — split: video overlay image + text with checklist + CTA
5. Features Grid — 4-column icon cards
6. Prevention — light purple bg, 2x2 grid tips + right text
7. How to Protect — do/don't checklists + illustration
8. Symptoms — light purple bg, 2x2 symptom cards + help line banner
9. News — 3 blog cards with date overlays
10. Footer — about + social, 3 link columns, copyright

## Design notes
- Primary color: #6f42c1 (purple)
- Font: Mulish (Google Fonts)
- Buttons: pill shape (border-radius 30px), uppercase, purple bg
- Alternating sections use bg-primary-light (rgba(111,66,193,0.05))
- Card backgrounds: #f8f9fa
- Green accent: #a8df65 (check marks)
- Dark text on white/light sections; gray body text
